network_api.note: WorkManager's network-constraint tracking (androidx.work, used by core/updates UpdateScheduler for the scheduled update check, which runs only with NetworkFeature.PACK_DOWNLOADS or APP_UPDATES on). Also the source of ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. No app code calls ConnectivityManager.

WorkManager's network-constraint tracking (androidx.work, used by core/updates UpdateScheduler for the scheduled update check, which runs only with NetworkFeature.PACK_DOWNLOADS or APP_UPDATES on). Also the source of ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. No app code calls ConnectivityManager. MapLibre's ConnectivityReceiver (a broadcast receiver that reads connectivity state and tells MapLibre's core whether the device is online) also reads this type: state getters only, no sockets, no egress, so no toggle.

Referenced by the HttpURLConnection path (core/network, gated by NetworkGate and the NetworkFeature toggles) and by libraries (OkHttp, which MapLibre depends on, Guava, JNA's URLClassLoader). App code itself imports only HttpURLConnection, URL, URLEncoder (query encoding in core/routing GasPrices, core/transit TransitRealtime, core/traffic FiveElevenNy) and three exception types (checked in the sources, 2026-10-04).

The app's own HTTP client: core/network NetworkGate.get and GitHubReleases, the only app code that opens a connection. Every request in app code goes through :core:network NetworkGate (CLAUDE.md), one NetworkFeature toggle per feature (pack downloads on by default, all others off). It is not the only HTTP client in the APK: MapLibre Native carries its own (OkHttp), unused because the style is bundled and tiles are pmtiles://file://, and valhalla-mobile's com/valhalla/valhalla/http/ValhallaHttpClient is a second client outside NetworkGate, inert because Valhalla's default.json has no mjolnir.tile_url and core/routing OfflineRouter sets only tile_extract. The baseline cannot prove either from the APK.

hosts.note: 511NY traffic events, cameras and message signs: core/traffic FiveElevenNy.kt (the http:// forms are only matched and upgraded to https, never fetched as http), camera images via feature/explore TrafficCameraCard. Gated by NetworkFeature.TRAFFIC_511NY (Settings > Live data, off by default, user-entered key). FiveElevenNy.absoluteUrl passes any absolute camera-image URL in the feed through unchanged to NetworkGate.get (redirects followed), so whatever hosts the 511NY feed names are contacted under TRAFFIC_511NY when a camera image loads, and are not in this baseline.

Southbound's own GitHub releases: core/network GitHubReleases.kt, used by core/updates for map packs (NetworkFeature.PACK_DOWNLOADS, on by default) and new app versions (NetworkFeature.APP_UPDATES, off by default). github.com is accepted as a redirect host for the release asset download. GitHubReleases.isAllowed accepts api.github.com, github.com and any *.githubusercontent.com over HTTPS, checked on every redirect hop. The release asset bytes come from *.githubusercontent.com, which the gate cannot record (a leading-dot suffix is not a host literal; a gate 2.1 item), so those hosts are contacted but are not in this list.
Text in the Settings hint 'Needs a free key from bustime.mta.info' (feature/settings strings.xml). Not a request.

Valhalla's httpd.service.listen setting (tcp://*:8002) in its bundled default configuration (com/valhalla/valhalla/default.json) and the matching default in valhalla-models-config. That is the standalone valhalla_service server's address; valhalla-mobile runs the engine in-process and the app only calls its actor API, but that nothing listens on it has not been verified on a device.
